aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a behavioral science major travels to a remote woodland retreat to investigate a series of mysterious murders at Capps Crossing, she becomes trapped in a dangerous web of deceit involving a local park ranger and his troubled son.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: During a getaway deep in the woods, behavioral science student Amber and her friends find themselves targeted by a murderous killer operating around Capps Crossing. Leveraging her sharp athletic skills and expertise in psychological profiling, Amber attempts to outmaneuver the killer in a desperate battle for survival. However, as hidden motives and shifting perceptions begin to surface, she uncovers a twisted network of lies linked to the local ranger and his son. Ultimately, Amber must discern truth from deception before she and her friends become the next victims.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Amber, a gifted behavioral science student and accomplished athlete, travels to the dense forest of Capps Crossing alongside her friends for a weekend retreat. What begins as a relaxing getaway rapidly devolves into a nightmare when a lethal predator begins targeting the group one by one. As panic sets in, Amber relies on her keen understanding of human behavior and psychological profiling to anticipate the attacker's next move. She soon discovers that the killings are inextricably tied to the local park ranger and his son, whose dark past masks sinister secrets. Navigating the treacherous terrain, Amber uncovers a web of manipulation, lies, and calculated betrayal designed to keep the truth buried. Every attempt to reach safety is thwarted by carefully planned traps, forcing Amber into a high-stakes game of cat-and-mouse. As the line between reality and deception blurs, she realizes that the threat is far more complex than a simple forest killer. Pushed to her absolute physical and mental limits, Amber must confront the deceptive forces controlling Capps Crossing to escape with her life.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Capps Crossing: Wrong Side of Dead is a tense psychological horror-thriller centered on Amber, a brilliant behavioral science major and skilled athlete. Seeking a break from her studies, Amber embarks on a birthday trip with her friends into the isolated woods of Capps Crossing, only to stumble into a deadly trap. As a murderous figure terrorizes the group, Amber is forced to utilize her expertise in human behavior and mental profiling to unravel the motives driving the violence. Her investigation uncovers a dark, manipulative web surrounding the local park ranger and his son. Blending slasher elements with intricate psychological suspense, the film explores themes of survival, perception, and betrayal as Amber fights to outsmart a killer where nothing is as it appears.
